name: SPECTRUM SBS480CBV 40V Cordless Leaf Blower Vacuum, 3-in-1 Blow/Vac/Mulch, 52m/s Airspeed, 12L Bag, 30:1 Mulch Ratio - Bare Tool
Body Copy:
Three jobs from one cordless tool: clear the lawn, vacuum the leaves, then shred them straight into the bag. The Spectrum SBS480CBV is a 40V blower vacuum built around a three-blade mulching system that reduces collected debris by 30 to 1, so a 12-litre bag lasts considerably longer between empties.

In blower mode the motor reaches 52m/s air speed at 264m³/h, strong enough for damp leaves stuck against fences and lawn edges. Switching to vacuum lifts air volume to 588m³/h and routes everything through the mulcher before it reaches the bag. At 4.26kg with an adjustable handle, the tool stays manageable across longer sessions; the brushed motor runs noticeably quieter than a petrol equivalent and needs no fuel.

This is a tool-only model. It runs on the Spectrum 40V battery platform, with 2.0Ah and 4.0Ah packs and matching chargers all purchased separately. Backed by a 5-year manufacturer warranty.
Unique Selling Point 01: Three tools in one: blow, vacuum and mulch from one cordless unit
Unique Selling Point 02: 52m/s airspeed in blower mode clears wet leaves and heavy debris
Unique Selling Point 03: 588m³/h vacuum air volume for fast, efficient collection
Unique Selling Point 04: 30:1 mulching ratio fills the collection bag 30x slower than without mulching
Unique Selling Point 05: 12-litre collection bag for manageable carrying weight
Unique Selling Point 06: Adjustable handle for ergonomic use during longer sessions
Unique Selling Point 07: Lightweight 4.26kg body, far less tiring than petrol alternatives
Unique Selling Point 08: Backed by a 5-year Spectrum manufacturer warranty (T&Cs apply)
Selling Copy: Cordless 40V blower, vacuum and mulcher in one tool. 52m/s airspeed clears wet leaves and patio debris; switch to vacuum and the 3-blade mulcher shreds garden waste at a 30:1 ratio into the 12-litre bag. 4.26kg with adjustable handle. Part of the Spectrum 40V cordless garden system, with batteries and chargers sold separately.
